newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN WINE MAKER JOIN BUCHAREST BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN WINE MAKER JOIN BUCHAREST BOURSE.

text.p: Romanian wine maker Prodvinalco SA will join second-tier trading on the Bucharest bourse on Tuesday, when pharmaceuticals firm Terapia will move to the first tier, the stock exchange said on Monday.

"Terapia has applied for a first-tier quotation and as it is a highly liquid company, meeting first-tier listings criteria, its application has been approved," said Doru Nicolaescu, member of the bourse committee.

When Prodvinalco joins the market, the total number of traded stocks will rise to 29. Three stocks -- chemical plant Oltchim , Azomures fertiliser maker and newcomer Terapia -- are traded on the first tier.
Prodvinalco, based in the Transylvanian city of Cluj, has a share capital of 9.066 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei.
The company was part of a mass selloff under which Romanians subscribed for a 60 percent stake in exchange for coupons. The remaining 40 is held by the State Ownership Fund.
A bourse statement said listing applications from another four companies had been approved but it did not say when their shares were to start trading.
